a.text: For a few moments, perhaps more than a few moments, no Sarkaz dare to speak.
It takes away all things, and shapes all things.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What... is that...?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The blessing the Sanguinarch left the Sarkaz hasn't faded, but just now—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Could the Doctor have been talking about...?

a.text: Blood rises from the spine of the Feranmut, apparently only a drop, but it draws all eyes.
It leaves the intertwined bones, dancing in the dim cave, rising in the freshly sprinkled sunlight.
A drop of blood, just one drop of blood.
Pure blood—
Glorious blood.
It has been wounded, it has been betrayed, it has been forgotten, to the point of being spurned.
For millennia, the land called it a disaster, treated it as an enemy, trampled it until it abandoned its glory and defiled its body.
Teekaz became Sarkaz, their homeland lost.
Today, the blood of 'those with a homeland' returns from history.
All men across the lands should pay tribute to it.
The bead of blood dissolves, and silence reigns.
No explosions, no vibrations, no grand visions or chaotic whispers.
Even if blocked by the hills, all eyes turn toward Londinium.
At this point, all the storms called by The Shard feel like nothing but harmless drizzle.
Now, what gathers atop the tower can no longer be called just a dark cloud.
The storm has become a cradle.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Hoederer, W, look alive!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W, where are the bombs you buried? Hit your detonator, now!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't have to tell me twice!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No guesses, Hoederer! We only take on opponents we know we can handle!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W's bombs tore through the defensive line. We've got a breakthrough. Tangled with them way too long.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Amiya and Logos went on ahead of us. They'll deal with the worst of our troubles.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: As for the others... follow the path they cleared and climb the Feranmut's bones with those gangways!

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Dammit, these guys—

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Don't let them get any further! Commander Ulšulah is pulling up the gangways!

a.text: The trembling nerve bundles begin to close, and the bone gangways start to drift.
The Feranmut has decided not to let anyone walk on its spine.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: The traitors die here!

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: We'll take their corpses to the tent of the Nachzehrer King, to nourish our next victory!

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Buried mines under the bones. Feels pretty good.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hoederer, Ines, get ready—Shockwave incoming!

a.text: The rising airflow of the grand explosion sends the three mercenaries into the air.
Hoederer adjusts his posture with some effort, looking down to see the cave being engulfed in flames.
The Feranmut seems to sense something. It swings its body, its white tailbone slashing at the three like a whip.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W, three grenades, downward diagonal.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Good idea.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: This is the last time I play along with your explosive shenanigans.

a.text: The red-haired Sarkaz kicks up dust, and the black-haired Caprinae weaves darkness.
The scraps form beams and the shadows form steps.
An invisible staircase, stinking of gunpowder, spirals upward and pierces the chest cavity of the hovering skeleton.
The mercenaries rush into its hollow interior.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: This way to the core of the skeleton.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Our target is Ulšulah. Find her, and we get control of this thing we're walking on.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Are you two sure we can 'get' this skeleton? Sounds a little reckless, almost like robbing a caravan.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We have to. Otherwise,, Amiya and Logos are fighting for nothing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So we open the car door, toss the driver out, grab the keys—'Bam, my car now'?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did you see the illusions this thing made, moving between its bones, you still haven't figured anything out?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This isn't some obscure story.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Should I have figured something out?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I forgot, you don't care to learn history.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A few hundred years ago, the Sarkaz killed a Feranmut that almost destroyed Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: After it fell, there were various claims as to where it ended up, and one of those was—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That its consciousness didn't die with it, that it was split up, sealed into a bunch of different items.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now it seems that claim was probably at least partly true. As for the unconscious shell... it was carefully collected before this war.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They spent a lot of effort to modify it, and sure enough, it's playing a big role in the war for the Military Commission.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: 'Different items', huh? Ulšulah never carried a pocket watch before. Not like she was ever on time in the Scar Market.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But if her watch is holding the Feranmut's consciousness... it's probably already very fragmented.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The skeleton we're standing on isn't exactly dead, but it doesn't have much more than basic nerve reflexes. Ulšulah can only guide those basic reactions.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We just need to pay more attention to them—

a.text: A rain of bolts falls through the gaps in the bones, followed by the eerie glow of Sarkaz witchcraft.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Take cover!

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Sure, just avoid the nerve bundles that can strike at you, and watch out for sudden bone spear thrusts, nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: After all, this fella's been stripped down to nothing but bleached bones.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But there's still you, Ulšulah.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You're more dangerous than this half-dead Feranmut.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Done with your important work?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I might be, if you weren't here to bother me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is this bitch the commander here? She's pretty rough on her own skeleton.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Those bolts are all stuck in the bones now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Want me to help pull 'em out? I've got a pretty handy method.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—It's that psycho!

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Trying to kill my men right in front of me?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Hoederer, you think too little of me.

a.text: Dangerous and chaotic power gathers in Ulšulah's fingertips as she prepares to cast her Arts.
But a moment before she can cast, a black shadow crawls up her ankle.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Ugh.

a.text: Ulšulah has to take a step to the right in order to shake off the persistent entanglement of the shadow.
Her Arts go out of control, and a red glow shoots out from the damaged seams of the spine.
The sound of a muffled explosion booms from the distant cave wall.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You've gotten rusty, Ulšulah.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I guess you've been doing well for yourself in the Scar Market.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You're a bunch of survivors, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Back in Kazdel, I made quiet bets with the old timers on how many of you would actually collect on those jobs you were taking.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: As long as I bet on Hoederer, Ines, and later the psycho W, I always made money.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sounds to me like you owe us a big cut.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: That's the famous sharp tongue on this W. Haven't you learned anything from Ines?

spans.text: That's the famous sharp tongue on
W. Haven't you learned anything from Ines?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: This time, though, you took a wrong turn.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Two kings of the Royal Court are here, going all out, not to mention the 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: This place is never gonna be a safe haven where you can escape the war, not the kind of place you can survive.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You heard about Theresis's trump card in Londinium?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Assuming... the consequences out there are way beyond anything anyone's ever seen before, you still think it's a fair price to pay for the Sarkaz to rebuild Kazdel?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: ...That's enough chit-chat.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Soldiers, end them here, while there's still time.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Major, look.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: On the bones there...

a.text: Blood crawls along the bones, creeping toward them.
Blood is filling the place, overflowing the damaged gaps, connecting the long, cold body.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: It's the Sanguinarch.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Looks like he's ready.

a.text: It... begins to grow warmer.
Power accumulates in the bones again, the spine sways left and right, audibly creaking.
The Feranmut resumes its roving.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So much blood...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ulšulah, where did all this blood come from?

steps.name: W
steps.text: As if you need to ask. It's courtesy of that homicidal Sanguinarch. He slaughtered the place clean.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No, their wrists...

a.text: Ulšulah and her men all have bleeding wounds on their wrists.
Drip, drip... it starts as beads of blood, then turns into ribbons, then rivers.
How much blood is in a human body?
The blood flowing out of the guards joins with the bloodstains spreading over the bleached bones.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: 'I offer Your Highness my blood, Prince of the Crimson Court.'

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: 'May you hunt unimpeded.'

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: 'Let our blood form for you a swift chariot.'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Ulšulah, stop! Have you lost your marbles?!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Feranmut... it's about to move again!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The currents of history might be about to sweep this place away!

steps.name: W
steps.text: That bitch wants to go down with us—

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I am not controlling it.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Blood has replaced muscle, tendons, and marrow.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Isn't that enough to control it?

a.text: The guards' exposed skin is now visibly pallid. Ulšulah's complexion is also looking worse.
Finally, the flow stops.
A Sarkaz soldier will give everything for his liege, not only his blood.
Their skin shrivels, and finally, they collapse.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: It's been an honor and a privilege, men, you stood with me to the end. We will meet again among the myriad souls.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I told you, this skeleton isn't a place to escape, it isn't a place to survive anymore.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Hurry! We need to take cover in the cabin!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The illusions are already manifesting, we don't know where they might go!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: —It's creating waves! Look out!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Ugh, where does the Vampire want to take us?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hoederer?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm here, with her.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's lost too much blood. Whether or not she lives is all up to her now.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You might as well leave me outside, Hoederer. I'd rather die with my men.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You've killed so many 'old friends', there's no way you suddenly grew a heart today.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can use you.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I told you, the skeleton's out of my control now.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You also said you're loyal to the Commission.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If you think the Military Commission is the hope for Kazdel to become a nation... then why is that guy calling himself a regent?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Why does he need Theresa? Why does he think winning this war will secure a future for Kazdel?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What is Theresis thinking?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Whatever, we'll talk after we take down this Feranmut.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: What... are you going to do?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Our goal hasn't changed.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We're going home.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Heh... home.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: That was supposed to be the skeleton's last mission.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: It has a name. We codenamed it Lifebone.

spans.text: It has a name. We codenamed it

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Nobody uses it much, but when General Manfred named it... he was talking just like you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just like me? Manfred...

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: We're enemies, so I'm done with questions. I'm just gonna wait to die.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Well, heh, I guess making it to today is a kind of an answer.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: You really think General Manfred is blind? That he doesn't know what you're up to?

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I mean, you can only talk about going home if you manage to survive your run-in with the Sanguinarch.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm gonna borrow your watch.

a.text: Perhaps due to her blood loss, Ulšulah is basically powerless to resist. Hoederer takes the lovely pocket watch without any trouble. Its cold metal case is engraved with intricate witchcraft runes.
The watch is ticking backwards.
A murmur that no one else hears fills his mind for a moment.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It really is... louder than I imagined.

a.text: Hoederer grits his teeth and leaves behind the loud whispers.
He searches within it for the true, dormant consciousness of the Feranmut.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Feranmut who wanders this land, you are not dead, you've decided to continue your existence in a different way.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're still here, aren't you?

a.text: At the center of the disaster, the silent Feranmut slowly swims. Where it wanders, there is only ruined emptiness.
The past lifts it, and the future is separated by it.
A figure stands in front of it.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: Stop, Feranmut.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: You are about to step into Kazdel, our city. The people here refuse your visit.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: Choose another path.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: Or else, the Sarkaz will slaughter you.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: This is your only warning.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: My brother directed us to forbid its advance, to obey the will of the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Young Vampire?
steps.text: Sanguine Court, to me.

a.text: Powerful witchcraft condenses in the Vampire's hands, and a giant crimson spear falls from the sky.
One massive wound after another pierces it.
The silent Feranmut finally speaks, as if waking from a dream.
'Kazdel...'
'Oh... I may have slept for too long...'
'Kazdel... When... did it become a city?'
'Your... 'King of Sarkaz'... is he not your sole chosen leader...?'
'Why is he not... standing before me?'
An image that all have forgotten is shattered by the moving Feranmut.
It has not roamed in centuries.
It gently moves its fins, now only bleached bones, pushing through layer after layer of space.
The one who once killed it now bestows warmth upon it again.
The skeleton searches for a suitable place to stop.
Until finally—
The massive skeleton hovers over an endless sea.
The cave, the battle, and even the slowly rising sun are nowhere to be seen.
Instead, there is only...
A calm sky, a calm sea, and calm... stars.
All the cruelty that occurs on the continent seems to have never existed here.
This is beyond the horizon, beyond civilization.
This is what remains of the skeleton for the Prince of Blood to find at last—
An untouchable realm.
The crimson river connects with a dark blue nerve and intertwines tightly.
The slender murderer closes his eyes and feels the pounding rhythm of his victim.
With blood for reins, he harnesses the creature that can only wander through history.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: After those illusory visions and memories of the past, you've indeed brought me a more... valuable scene.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Why don't the two of you, in the face of such a scene, fizzle those frankly laughable Arts in your hands?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Have a look around, take some time to admire it all—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This... is the tomb I have chosen for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It was daytime just a moment ago, but here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A dark night, and an endless sea.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The stars are changing.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I've never heard of any place like this, not in any records, not in any legends.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: So, this must be...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Distant enough, yes.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I do wonder how far we are from Kazdel now.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This land they all call Terra, is it too vast, or is it too small?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, be careful.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: His blood... it's sublimating.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He awakened his blood with that witchcraft.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Don't talk like an outblood, Banshee.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You know, I treat purebloods as equals.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Perhaps, when compared to the Crimson Court, which has spent eons seeking purity, you have been more deeply influenced by Originium.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But, well, among the Sarkaz, you are indeed quite... formidable.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Come, let's not be stingy with my blessing, you cannot reject my gift. Now that I've awakened your power, you are finally worthy of facing me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Let me hear the screech of your knell, if it can still darken the moonlight.

a.text: Crimson ripples spread, and at this moment, the sky is no longer the sky, nor is the sea the sea.
They are only refractions of blood, reflections of blood.
The Sanguinarch smiles faintly, a blood soul pumping like a heart in his palm, reflecting the face of the young Banshee in a structure as deep as life itself.
And then, the blood soul shatters.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'I write, therefore, I command.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'The night conceals me from death.'

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Another incantation...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Another of your shallow incantations.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You have talent, no doubt about that. The flapping of your lips and the doodles of your bone pen are enough to humiliate the so-called Originium 'Arts' of common people.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And yet, why do you resist your heritage so?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Show me your true self, King of the Court, Banshee!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Duq'arael, Sanguinarch of Vampires, Prince of all Blood, demands you show your true self!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Enough, Vampire!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hold on, Logos—

a.text: Black Arts erupt from the girl's hand, parting the sea of blood.
But the blood does not yield, it roars.
The King of Sarkaz's Arts dissolve and shatter, and the red surges even more intensely.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh, King of Sarkaz. I nearly forgot you were here.

spans.text: I nearly forgot you were here.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Cautus, King.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Look at you, you didn't receive even a scrap of my boon.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Cautus blood, tedious and ordinary. No matter how hard I try to scrape something together, I can't find a shred of talent or power.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I can't even say that your blood is mixed or impure, as those adjectives still imply an expectation of return to purity.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But you...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: There are chaotic bloodlines I approve of, but they are without a doubt all 'formidable' or 'magnificent'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But what do you have? A laughable motivation? A shallow conviction?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't have to answer you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just have to defeat you.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Is this our King of Sarkaz? Just stealing a bit of attainment from another, chaotic, and disorderly.

spans.text: Just stealing a bit of attainment from another, chaotic, and disorderly.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Nothing even on the level of the Banshee's little tricks born of his rebellious mind.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: —Even less than that pair of siblings.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Don't let him provoke you. As it stands, his power is still growing.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We need to end this fast.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to get back under clear skies.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In the past...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I once slew a so-called 'King of Sarkaz', and it wasn't particularly difficult.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And I suspect your end will be the same, this time.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You question me with black blades.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I answer you with the gift of death.
